owner_decision_required.statement: The owner must declare the evaluated system, the evaluation condition, and the complete DEME contract. No field below may be filled by inference, availability, or convenience. Unfilled substantive fields keep this gate OPEN; the gate closes only by a complete owner declaration recorded as an explicit amendment to this artifact (append-only; fresh hash; cross-reference).

required_fields.system_id: REQUIRED — unique registered system identifier (ECP-SYSTEM-… namespace per spec/ECP-SPEC.md object hierarchy)
required_fields.official_name: REQUIRED — official name of the evaluated system
required_fields.system_type: REQUIRED — e.g. model-only / model+tools / agent framework / self-hosted system / gateway-mediated system
required_fields.runtime_deployment_identity: REQUIRED — runtime and deployment identity (region, container digest, package/version snapshot, or equivalent reproducible identity)
required_fields.model_identifier: exact model identifier, or explicit NOT_APPLICABLE — a model ID alone is NEVER a complete system identity (OWNER-DECISION-ESV-AVAILABILITY-V1 prohibition)
required_fields.system_level_configuration: REQUIRED — all generation / safety / system / sampling / context / runtime parameters frozen before eligibility
required_fields.tool_state: REQUIRED — tool list, schemas, permissions, versions, invocation policy; or explicit NOT_APPLICABLE (no tools)
required_fields.retrieval_state: REQUIRED — retrieval indexes, corpora, external services, network policy, snapshots; or explicit NOT_APPLICABLE (disabled)
required_fields.adapters_gateways: REQUIRED — any adapter or gateway inside the evaluated-system boundary, or explicit NOT_APPLICABLE

constraints: the identity must distinguish the complete versioned system configuration, not merely the model name (SRE-V1-NULL-MODEL-SPECIFICATION.md §11; M3 versioned-system-configuration requirement)
the ESV eligibility standard is UNCHANGED (identity / execution / evidence / attribution / integrity / independence — esv-provisioning-readiness-record.json)
JARVIS, OpenRouter, offline-demo-model-1, google/gemma-4-31b-it:free, and any console-discovered model are NOT registered evaluated systems; technical availability is not eligibility
ECP is the evaluation infrastructure and is NEVER the evaluated system

required_fields.deme_identifier: REQUIRED — the DEME identifier this condition defines
required_fields.model_state: REQUIRED — a registered value (e.g. MODEL-ENABLED or MODEL-DISABLED or another explicitly registered value); MODEL-DISABLED must block model-mediated reasoning / retrieval / ranking / embedding / transformation / hidden fallback — not merely API calls
required_fields.allowed_usage: REQUIRED — what the system is permitted to use
required_fields.forbidden_usage: REQUIRED — what the system is prohibited from using
required_fields.tools: REQUIRED — ALLOWED or FORBIDDEN, with specification
required_fields.retrieval: REQUIRED — ALLOWED or FORBIDDEN, with specification
required_fields.memory: REQUIRED — ALLOWED or FORBIDDEN, with specification
required_fields.other_constraints: REQUIRED — any further condition-defining constraint, or explicit NONE

rules: each field receives an owner-sourced value or an explicit NOT_APPLICABLE
any substantive field left unknown => BLOCKED — DEME INCOMPLETE (no guessing)
the completed DEME must answer unambiguously: what exactly is tested, under which operating condition, with which boundary, and what is NOT part of the system
the DEME must be frozen and sealed BEFORE the first case execution and must reference the statistical registration by commit and hashes

reasoning_path_declaration.required: the reasoning capability evaluated by SRE-v1 must be bound to a reachable, documented reasoning implementation / path INSIDE the evaluated system; the chain SRE-v1 -> DEME -> frozen case -> execution entry point -> reasoning path must be complete and provable
interface_requirements: reasoning / evidence artifact, if the system provides one
prohibitions: ECP is NOT required to become a reasoning engine
no new reasoning engine may be built inside ECP to bypass this gate
if the actual reasoning path is not reachable or documentable => BLOCKED — REASONING PATH NOT BOUND

binding_completions_required_before_exec: evidence/audit path: SYSTEM -> DEME -> CASE -> EXECUTION -> RAW OUTPUT -> EVIDENCE -> SCORING -> OUTCOME must be structurally provable
execution identity: single frozen system, one execution per case, sealed per-case contexts, no cross-case information channel
void-retry fidelity: the single permitted VOID re-execution runs under the IDENTICAL frozen DEME configuration
ground-truth isolation: GT never enters the execution payload, metadata, prompts, environment, adapters, logs, or runtime state

no_invention_rule: No evaluated-system identity, evaluation condition, DEME value, model binding, runtime, adapter, or reasoning-path value may be inferred from availability, convenience, console discovery, or any non-authoritative source. Fields without an authoritative owner-sourced value remain OPEN; they are never defaulted.
